title: Cryo Container Manifest
description: manifest.json — the mandatory first entry of a .cryo container. Valid only if the five required keys are present: format, version, kind, name, contents. Only entry (and $schema/preview) are optional. Per-kind structural rules are the `allOf` conditionals below.

$schema.description: Reference to this schema; enables editor validation.

kind.description: Semantic category Kosmos dispatches on. Known kinds: scene, material, shader, asset-pack (each requires `entry`; shader also requires a shader-index.json). The value stays open for future kinds.

contents.description: Entry inventory. May be empty, but the key must be present.

entry.description: Optional. Path of the primary payload, e.g. 'scenes/main.cryo.xml'.

frostboot.description: Optional. Path of a deterministic-boot frostboot.yaml file: a narrow {wait, camera, script} boot recipe, NOT the loom-orchestrated .kosaction job format. CURRENTLY UNCONSUMED -- its only reader was irisagent's FrostBootLoader, retired with that binary (see runtime/iris/docs/RETIRED-irisagent-formats.md, which preserves the format). Kept declared so existing manifests stay valid.

afrost.description: Optional. Path of a .afrost agent descriptor, to drive an agent turn-loop over iris daemon capabilities after the `frostboot` boot completes. CURRENTLY UNCONSUMED from a container, same reason as `frostboot`. The .afrost format itself is alive -- the Electron chat panel reads it directly -- just not via this field.

preview.description: Optional. Link to a preview image — a container-internal path (e.g. '.kosmos/preview.png') or an external URL.

path.description: Relative, forward-slash path within the container.

size.description: Byte length of the entry body.

sha256.description: Optional hex sha256 of the entry body.
